items.information: 🇧🇷 **Português** ** Bem-vindos à primeira competição de Cubo Mágico do Planalto Médio do Rio Grande do Sul !!!! ** Localizada no norte do Estado do Rio Grande do Sul, na região conhecida como Planalto Médio, a cidade de Passo Fundo destaca-se pela representatividade nas áreas médica, cultural, educacional, agrícola de precisão e tecnológica. Por estar localizada numa região estratégica do Rio Grande do Sul e próxima do centro e oeste de Santa Catarina, o Passo Fundo Cubing 2025 promete a inserção do Cubo Mágico em um espaço pouco alcançado até o momento, trazendo a promessa de crescimento do esporte numa verdadeira expansão para os atletas que buscam as possibilidades de participação nos campeonatos oficiais. Agora chegou a vez de Passo Fundo alcançar a representatividade também no Esporte para o Cérebro! Divulgar esse esporte em nível oficial, e levar aos competidores a oportunidade de participação, é o objetivo solidário da organização e dos apoiadores, especialmente da Secretaria Municipal de Educação e da Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, que apoiam o evento! Nos vemos lá! 🇬🇧 **English:** ** Welcome to the first speedcubing competition in Passo Fundo - Rio Grande do Sul !!!! ** Located in the north of the state of Rio Grande do Sul, in the region known as "middle plateau", the city of Passo Fundo stands out due to its representation in medical, cultural, educational, precision farming and technology areas. Since it is located in a strategical region in Rio Grande do Sul and close to the center and West of the state of Santa Catarina, this competition is a certain path to introducing speedcubing somewhere not fully reached yet, with the promise of growth to the sport, bringing a chace of participating in official competitions. Now it is Passo Fundo's turn to reach its representation in the mind sport too! Spreading this sport officially and taking the opportunity to the competitors are the objectives of the organisers and supporters, especially of Secretaria Municipal de Educação and of Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, who support the event! We will meet there!

items.information: # Première Compétition Officielle de Speedcubing en Côte d’Ivoire! Un moment historique! Rejoignez-nous le **samedi 19 avril** pour la toute première compétition officielle WCA en **Côte d’Ivoire**! Que vous soyez un compétiteur expérimenté ou un nouveau venu dans le monde du speedcubing, c’est l’occasion parfaite de participer à cet événement unique. Quatre épreuves officielles sont au programme : **3x3**, **2x2**, **Pyraminx** et **3x3 à une main**. Vous pouvez choisir de participer à l'une ou à toutes! **Première compétition WCA?** Pas de souci! Un **tutoriel pour les débutants** vous expliquera tout ce qu’il faut savoir sur la compétition et l’arbitrage. N’oubliez pas d’apporter une **pièce d’identité** pour l’inscription. Ne manquez pas cette occasion historique - venez résoudre, concourir et faire partie de la communauté grandissante du speedcubing en Côte d’Ivoire! # Ivory Coast’s First-Ever Official WCA Competition! History is being made! Join us on **Saturday, April 19th**, for the first-ever WCA speedcubing competition in **Ivory Coast**! Whether you're a seasoned competitor or brand new to cubing, this is your chance to be part of something special. We'll be holding four official events, including **3x3**, **2x2**, **Pyraminx**, and **One-Handed** - compete in any or all of them! **New to WCA competitions?** No worries! We’ll have a **newcomer tutorial** to guide you through competing and judging. Just bring a form of ID for registration, and get ready to experience the thrill of official speedcubing. Don’t miss this historic event - come solve, compete, and be part of Ivory Coast’s growing cubing community!

items.information: ![(https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png) ## FMC Canada 2025 ### [EN] This competition is **Canada's championship for 3x3x3 Fewest Moves** as we will not hold the event at [Canadian Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChampionnatCanadien2025). The top-three Canadian competitors will be recognized for the national podium. This competition will have competitors simultaneously competing in 3x3x3 Fewest Moves at different locations across Canada with one winner. This isn't your typical speed solving competition as 3x3x3 Fewest Moves is the only event. This is an **exam-style event** in which competitors spend up to an hour finding the shortest solution they can and **writing it down on paper**. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 speed solving event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). ### [FR] Cette compétition est le **Championnat canadien de 3x3x3 résolution optimisée (ou FMC)** car nous n'organiserons pas cette épreuve lors du [Championnat Canadien 2025] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChampionnatCanadien2025). Les trois premiers compétiteurs canadiens seront reconnus pour le podium national. Dans le cadre de cette compétition, des compétiteurs participeront simultanément à l'épreuve du 3x3x3 résolution optimisée à différents endroits au Canada et un seul gagnant sera désigné. Il ne s'agit pas d'une compétition typique où il faut résoudre le plus vite possible, car la seule épreuve est le 3x3x3 résolution optimisée. Il s'agit d'une **épreuve de type examen** au cours de laquelle les compétiteurs passent jusqu'à une heure à trouver la solution la plus courte possible et à **l'écrire sur papier**. Si vous cherchez à participer à une compétition de speedcubing plus classique, merci de chercher [une autre compétition au Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). --- ## Locations / Lieux ### [EN] Please see the [Locations tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2025#52204-locations-lieux) for more details. ### [FR] Merci de regarder [l'onglet lieux](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2025#52204-locations-lieux) pour plus de détails. --- ## Notice of Filming and Photography / Avis de droit à l'image ### [EN] Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ### [FR] Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## Please Be Quiet This isn't your typical speed solving competition as ***blindfolded events*** are the only events. Blindfolded events require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 Cube event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). ## FMC Canada 2025 We will take a break in the middle of the day to hold [FMC Canada 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2025) at the same venue. You may compete in both competitions, but **you must register for each competition separately**. ## Note for New Competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you. You can also follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ## Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. items.information: # 본 대회는 3x3x3 종목이 없습니다. # [참관객 제한](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBQKoreaSpring2025#53733-spectator-limit)이 존재합니다. ### 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대기자 명단에 등록됩니다. ### 신청 후 [참가자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/62/competitors)에서 본인의 이름을 확인하십시오. 이름이 보이지 않을 경우 [대기자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/62/waitlist)을 확인하여 주십시오. ### 주최측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인하시기 바랍니다. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ # There is no 3x3x3 event at this competition. # There is a [Spectator Limit](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBQKoreaSpring2025#53733-spectator-limit). ### Even if you successfully paid the registration fee, due to the first-come first-served basis for registration, you might be put on the waitlist. ### After registration, please check your name on the [competitor list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/62/competitors). Please check the [waitlist](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/62/waitlist) if your name is not on the competitor list. ### Please be sure to check emails sent by the organizers. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1) if you are not familiar with official WCA competitions.
